proposition: Ibn Turka wrote a Sharḥ al-Nahj / Tarjuma-yi Ahādīs az Ḥażrat-i Amīr pairing Sunni hadith on ʿAlī with Nahj al-Balāgha aphorisms, later copied almost verbatim by Qundūzī. As a work of his own, it is a witness to what he held, unlike the apologies.

mediation.who: Ibn Turka in his own doctrinal work, as summarised by MK
mediation.where: MS Majlis 10196 and other manuscripts as cited by MK

mediation.who: Melvin-Koushki, The Quest for a Universal Science (Yale 2012)
